query_plan.query: What is the average total assets of companies?

steps.merge_task: Deduplicate by company id, calculate the average total assets.
steps.query: Return all companies together with their total assets, with their company id and company name.

extra.sql_query: SELECT AVG(total_assets_usd) AS avg_total_assets FROM companies

s1.sql_query: SELECT companies.company, companies.name, companies.total_assets_usd FROM companies
